accountVerified.label: Account verified — {network}, on {date}
accountVerified.help: INFLUX confirmed this account belongs to the registered creator.

audienceVerified.label: Audience verified — {network}, on {date}
audienceVerified.help: Figures observed by INFLUX in the {network} native dashboard, period {start} to {end}. INFLUX makes no claim about follower authenticity.

badge.toRefresh: Audience verified on {date} — verification needs refreshing.
badge.toReconfirm: Account verified on {date} — to be reconfirmed after a handle change.

brandVerified.help: INFLUX checked, on the date shown, that this brand controls its domain and that its registration exists in a public register. INFLUX does not speak to its solvency or to the quality of its campaigns.

ownership.instructions: Paste this code into your {network} bio. We check it online ourselves. You can remove it as soon as the check is recorded.
ownership.neverAsk: INFLUX will never ask for your password, access to your account, or a code you received by message.

evidence.instructions: What we need to see: your account name, the period shown, your follower count. Hide or crop anything about other people.
evidence.freshness: Your screenshot must cover a period ending less than 30 days ago.

request.pending: Your request is being reviewed. We answer within 1 business day.
request.duplicate: A request for this network has been open since {date}.
request.expired: Your code has expired. You can generate a new one.

expiry.reminder: Your verified audience expires on {date}. Upload a recent screenshot to keep it.
expiry.toRefresh: Your verified audience needs refreshing. It stays visible with its date until {date}.
expiry.removed: Your verified audience has expired. Your figures are shown as declared again.

dispute.open: You can appeal this decision for 30 days.

advertiser.disclaimer: This badge means a figure was checked by INFLUX against evidence on the date shown. It does not guarantee follower authenticity or campaign results.

line.title: Verification of this account
line.loading: Reading the state of the verification…
line.unavailable: The state of the verification could not be read. Nothing is lost.
line.needIdentifier: First fill in the handle and the link of this account: without them, the agent does not know where to look for the code.

absent.account: Not verified yet. An INFLUX agent confirms that this account is yours by reading a code on your public profile.
absent.audienceNeedsAccount: The audience is verified once the ownership of the account is confirmed on this network.

cta.fillIdentifier: Fill in the handle and the link

reason.missing_evidence: No evidence was attached to your request.
reason.evidence_too_old: The period shown on your screenshot ended more than 30 days ago.
reason.evidence_unreadable: The account or the period cannot be read on your screenshot.
reason.evidence_wrong_source: Only the network's official statistics are accepted. A screenshot from a third-party measurement tool cannot be used.
reason.evidence_too_wide: Your screenshot shows information about other people. Crop it following our instructions.
reason.ownership_not_proven: The verification code was not found on your profile.
reason.account_not_public: We could not view your profile without being logged in. Make it public for the time of the check, or give up verifying this network.
reason.ownership_prerequisite: We first check that this account belongs to you, before observing your figures.
reason.evidence_inconsistent: The information provided does not match.
reason.shared_account: This account seems to be run by several people. We cannot establish its ownership for an identified person.
reason.agency_managed: Accounts managed by an agency are not supported for the moment.
reason.terms_breach: Your profile does not comply with the INFLUX terms of use.
reason.minor: INFLUX is for adults only: we cannot process your request.
reason.account_unavailable: Your request cannot be processed while your account is suspended.
reason.other: Your request could not be accepted as it stands. The message from the INFLUX team:

next.redeposit: You will be able to upload new evidence, then ask for the verification again.
next.restartOwnership: You can start the proof of ownership again: you will be given a new code.
next.makePublic: Make your account public for the time of the check, then ask for the verification again.
next.askOwnershipFirst: First have the ownership of this account verified.
next.contact: To discuss it, contact INFLUX from the help on the sign-in screen.
next.none: No new request is possible for the moment.

ownership.title: Verify my {network} account
ownership.unavailable: We cannot show the verification right now. Nothing is lost: try again in a few minutes.

affirm.title: What this badge states
affirm.intro: Once an INFLUX agent has seen the code on your profile, the badge states four things, and not one more.

items.fact: That a precise fact was observed: here, that this account belongs to the registered creator.
items.evidence: That it was observed from evidence, not from a declaration: the agent reads the code on your public profile.
items.agent: That it was observed by a named INFLUX agent. The name stays internal.
items.date: That it was observed on a given date, from a given source: the date is shown next to the badge.

not.title: What it does not state
not.authenticity: INFLUX makes no claim about follower authenticity.
not.stability: That the audience will stay stable.
not.performance: What performance a campaign will get.
not.quality: That the creator is serious, professional, reliable or of quality.
not.commitments: That the creator will keep their commitments.

preview.title: What brands will see
preview.example: Example: the date shown will be the date of the check.
preview.never: Never shown: the handle of your account, a link to your profile, the name of the agent, the internal notes.

affirm.todo: To get it, INFLUX gives you a code to paste into the bio of your {network} account. An agent reads it online, without being logged in. It takes a few minutes.

code.title: Copy your code
code.label: Your code
code.copyFailed: Copying did not work: select the code and copy it by hand.

where.instagram: Where to paste it: in the bio of your Instagram profile.
where.tiktok: Where to paste it: in the bio of your TikTok profile.
where.youtube: Where to paste it: in the description of your YouTube channel (About section).
where.facebook: Where to paste it: in the intro of your Facebook page.
where.linkedin: Where to paste it: in the About section of your LinkedIn page.
where.x: Where to paste it: in the bio of your X profile.
where.snapchat: Where to paste it: in the description of your public Snapchat profile.
where.twitch: Where to paste it: in the About panel of your Twitch channel.
where.pinterest: Where to paste it: in the description of your Pinterest profile.
where.threads: Where to paste it: in the bio of your Threads profile.
where.other: Where to paste it: in a public, editable field of your profile, such as the bio or the description.

code.public: Your account must be viewable without logging in: if the code is not publicly visible, ownership is not established.

notAccepted.title: What we do not accept
notAccepted.intro: Only the code read online by the agent counts. None of these is accepted as proof:
notAccepted.dm: a private message sent from the account
notAccepted.connected: a screenshot of a logged-in space
notAccepted.bio: a screenshot of the bio field

code.renewHelp: A new code replaces the previous one right away.

confirm.title: Request sent
confirm.body: Request sent. An INFLUX agent will verify your account.
confirm.keepCode: Leave the code in your bio until the check is recorded. You can then remove it.
confirm.state: The state of the request is shown in the line of this network on your profile.
confirm.back: See the state on my profile

done.title: Account verified
done.removeCode: The check is recorded: you can remove the code from your bio.

locked.title: Have the account ownership verified first
locked.body: An INFLUX agent reads your figures in the dashboard of an account they know is yours. The ownership of your {network} account must therefore be verified before its audience.

affirm.title: What this badge states
affirm.intro: Once an INFLUX agent has checked your figures in the {network} dashboard, the badge states four things, and not one more.

items.fact: That your audience figures were checked: followers, posting rhythm, average comments per post.
items.evidence: That they were checked against evidence, not on your word: a screenshot of the native {network} dashboard.
items.agent: That they were checked by a named INFLUX agent. The name stays internal.
items.date: That they were checked on a given date, over a given period: the date, the period and the source are shown beside the badge.

affirm.refresh: Your audience badge needs refreshing: upload a recent screenshot to get a new one, dated the day of the new check.
affirm.todo: To get it, you upload one or more screenshots of the native {network} dashboard. An INFLUX agent reads the figures themselves: you type nothing.

preview.title: What brands will see
preview.help: Figures observed by INFLUX in the {network} native dashboard, with the period covered by your screenshot. INFLUX makes no claim about follower authenticity.
preview.example: Example: the date shown will be the date of the check.

public.title: Visible to a brand
public.level: The badge level and the network concerned.
public.period: The period covered by your screenshots.
public.bands: Your figures as ranges, never as exact values.

internal.title: Never shown to a brand
internal.exact: The exact figures observed: a brand reads them only once the identities of a connection have been revealed.
internal.gap: The gap between what you declared and what was observed.
internal.handle: Your account handle and the link to your profile.
internal.agent: The agent's name, their internal notes and the history of refusals.

deposit.title: Upload your screenshots

expected.title: The screenshot expected on {network}
expected.instagram: The professional account statistics ("Insights"). These must be readable: the account name, the follower count, the reach, the period shown, the main countries.
expected.tiktok: The account's analytics space. These must be readable: the account name, the followers, the views, the period, the territories.
expected.youtube: The creator space ("YouTube Studio"). These must be readable: the channel name, the subscribers, the views, the period, the countries.
expected.other: The native statistics tool of {network}, or its equivalent. The same requirements, no exception: the account name, the follower count and the period shown must be readable.
expected.thirdParty: A screenshot from a third-party measurement tool or an agency report, or figures retyped by hand, are never accepted.

instructions.title: Before you capture

see.title: What we need to see
see.text: Your account name, the period shown, your follower count.

hide.title: What you must hide or crop before sending
hide.text: The names and photos of other people, comments, messages, notifications, anything that is not your figures.

never.title: What we never ask for
never.text: Your password, access to your account, a screenshot of your private messages.

instructions.why: An analytics space often shows information about other people: a screenshot that is too wide is refused, then deleted at once.

deposit.formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP, {size} MB at most per image. PDFs are refused: take a screenshot instead.
deposit.private: Your screenshots are read by INFLUX agents only, never by a brand. The file name is neither read nor kept, and the hidden data of the image, such as where it was taken, is removed.

pieces.title: Your screenshots
pieces.count: {count, plural, one {# screenshot uploaded} other {# screenshots uploaded}}

deposit.chooseHelp: You can pick several at once: they are sent one after the other.
deposit.submitHelp: Upload at least one screenshot to send the request.

errors.empty: This file is empty: choose another one.
errors.unsupported_type: This file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. PDFs are refused: take a screenshot of the dashboard.
errors.undecodable: This image could not be read. Choose another one, or take the screenshot again.
errors.too_many_pixels: This image has too many pixels. Reduce its size and try again.
errors.too_small: This image is too small to be readable: its longest side must be at least {min} pixels.
errors.output_too_large: This image is too heavy once processed. Choose a lighter one.
errors.tooLarge: This image is over {size} MB. Choose a lighter one.
errors.quota: You have reached today's upload limit.
errors.quotaDelay: You have reached today's upload limit. You will be able to upload again in {delay}.
errors.cap: This request already holds the maximum number of screenshots. Remove one to add another.
errors.notDraft: This request has already been sent or can no longer be changed. The screen has just been updated.
errors.gone: This request no longer exists. The screen has just been updated.
errors.unavailable: The service is not answering. This image is not uploaded, your other screenshots are intact: try again in a moment.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.body: Request sent. An INFLUX agent will check your figures against your screenshots.
sent.private: Your screenshots are read by INFLUX agents only.

done.title: Audience verified
done.until: This badge expires on {date}. You will then be able to upload a recent screenshot to keep it.

brandBlock.affirms: What the badge states: the domain of your website belongs to you and your company is registered in a public register. It states nothing about solvency, seriousness or quality.
brandBlock.optional: The badge is not needed to submit your profile: requesting it counts in the completeness, and promises nothing about the review or the publication of the profile.
brandBlock.noDomain: Your profile can be published without a domain, but the badge cannot be requested: first fill in your brand's website, under "Public identity".

brand.title: Verify my brand
brand.unavailable: We cannot display the verification right now. Nothing is lost: try again in a few minutes.

affirm.title: What this badge states
affirm.intro: Once an INFLUX agent has checked your domain and your registration, the "Brand verified" badge states exactly two things, and not one more.

items.domain: That the domain of your website is controlled by your brand: the agent finds online a code that you publish on that domain.
items.registration: That the registration you declared exists in a public register: the agent looks it up himself.

affirm.byHand: It is granted by hand, by a named INFLUX agent, on a given date: the date is shown next to the badge.
affirm.refresh: Your badge needs refreshing: a new request gives a badge dated the day of the new check.

not.title: What it does not state
not.solvency: That your brand is solvent or that it will pay.
not.experience: That it has already worked with creators.
not.quality: That its campaigns are of good quality.

preview.title: What the badge will show
preview.example: Example: the date shown will be the day of the check.
preview.never: Never shown: your company's legal name, country and registration number, the agent's name, the internal notes.

affirm.todo: To obtain it, INFLUX gives you a code to publish on your domain, then you give your company's legal name, country and registration number. These three details stay internal: a creator never sees them.

publish.title: Publish your code
publish.intro: Publish this code on your domain, in one of the two ways below. We find it online ourselves.

ways.title: Choose one of the two ways

dns.title: A DNS record
dns.text: At your domain's registrar, add, at the root of your domain, a TXT record that contains the code. It can take a while to become visible.

page.title: A page of your website
page.text: Publish on your domain a page, reachable without signing in, that contains the code.

publish.public: The code must be readable without signing in: if it is not publicly visible, the domain is not controlled.
publish.neverAsk: INFLUX will never ask for your password, nor for access to your hosting or to your domain registrar.
publish.screenshot: Only the code the agent reads online counts: a screenshot of a record or of a page is not proof.
publish.submit: I published the code, send my request

details.title: Your company
details.intro: These three details are used to check your company's registration in a public register. They are asked now, when you request the badge, and not before.
details.required: This field is required to request the badge.

legalName.label: Legal name
legalName.help: Your company's legal name, as it appears in the register: not necessarily your trading name.

country.label: Country of registration
country.help: The country whose public register will be consulted.

number.label: Registration number
number.help: Enter it as it appears in your country's register.

sent.title: Request sent
sent.body: Request sent. An INFLUX agent will check your domain and your registration.
sent.keepCode: Leave the code in place on your domain until the check is recorded. You can then remove it.
sent.state: The state of the request is shown in the "Verification" block of your brand profile.
sent.back: See the state on my brand profile

done.title: Brand verified
done.removeCode: The check is recorded: you can remove the code from your domain.
done.until: This badge expires on {date}. You can then refresh it.

failure.duplicate: A request has already been open since {date}.

reason.domain_code_not_found: We found the code neither in your domain's DNS records nor on a page of your website.
reason.registration_not_found: This registration could not be found in your country's public register.
reason.registration_unverifiable_country: Registration cannot be checked in this country: INFLUX does not yet consult a free public register there. You can request the badge again once a source is added.
reason.name_mismatch: The legal name you entered does not match the register.
reason.account_unavailable: Your request cannot be processed while your account is suspended.
reason.other: Your request could not be accepted as it stands. The INFLUX team's message:

next.retryCode: Check that the code is published on your domain, then request the badge again: you will be given a new code.
next.fixDetails: Check the legal name, the country and the registration number, correct them if needed, then request the badge again.
next.retryLater: Come back to this screen later: the "Request the badge again" button stays available.

failure.retryLater: A request was refused a short while ago. You will be able to make a new one in {delay}.
failure.cap: Several requests were refused in the last days: a new request is not possible for the moment.
failure.alreadyVerified: The ownership of this account is already verified on this network.
failure.notDraft: This request has already been sent or can no longer be changed. The screen has just been updated.
failure.gone: This request no longer exists. The screen has just been updated.
failure.accountUnavailable: Your request cannot be processed while your account is suspended.
failure.unavailable: The service is not answering. Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.
failure.ownershipPrerequisite: Have the ownership of this account verified on this network first.
failure.missingEvidence: Upload at least one screenshot before sending the request.
failure.evidenceCap: This request already holds the maximum number of screenshots: remove one before adding another.
failure.websiteDomainRequired: The badge cannot be requested without a domain: first fill in your brand's website in your profile.
failure.internalDetailsRequired: Fill in your company's legal name, country and registration number before sending the request.
failure.detailsInvalid: One of your company's details is not accepted. Check the legal name, the country and the registration number.
